company.name: MABLE
company.shortDescription: MABLE produces a toothbrush made of bamboo and that is anti-microbial and bio-degradable.
company.description:
The MABLE brush stands on its own. No need for that old toothbrush cup. Throw that thing out!     

Crafted from sustainably harvested bamboo, naturally antibacterial, water resistant, and fully biodegradable.

To give your brush a piece of flair that's still eco-friendly, they use a plant-based, non-toxic paint, which is fully biodegradable.

The cardboard box is recyclable, and they are hard at work to make the protective fabric sleeve fully biodegradable in the near future.

Your MABLE brush will last a long time and perform just as well as any other brush. It’s really all in your brushing technique! The American Dental Association recommends you change your brush every 3-4 months, and they make that easy and convenient with their MABLE Club membership.
